about: Sunny lines of the handpan (Docs/12-new-instruments/handpan.md 8.2). lineSeconds = seconds + the 0.14 s lead.

lines.text: Tap the round notes gently with your fingertips.
lines.spoken: Tap the round notes gently with your fingertips.

lines.text: Tap, then lift quickly so the note rings.
lines.spoken: Tap, then lift quickly so the note rings.

lines.text: The deep note in the middle is the ding.
lines.spoken: The deep note in the middle is the ding.

lines.text: Gentle taps sound sweeter, hard taps brighter.
lines.spoken: Gentle taps sound sweeter, hard taps brighter.

lines.text: Tap near a dimple's edge for a richer note.
lines.spoken: Tap near a dimple's edge for a richer note.

lines.text: Rest your hand on the steel to quiet it.
lines.spoken: Rest your hand on the steel to quiet it.

lines.text: Slap the middle with a flat hand for a boom.
lines.spoken: Slap the middle with a flat hand for a boom.

lines.text: Tap between the notes for a soft click.
lines.spoken: Tap between the notes for a soft click.

lines.text: Play the handpan over your loop. It's in tune.
lines.spoken: Play the hand pan over your loop. It's in tune.
